title: Notice: Rescheduling of Walk-in Interviews for Visiting Faculty – Timergara Campus
text:
Rescheduling of Walk-in Interviews – Visiting Faculty (Timergara Campus)

The walk-in interviews for engagement of Visiting Faculty in the disciplines of

Mathematics, Computer Science, and Statistics

at
Timergara Campus
have been rescheduled.

The interviews will now be conducted on

October 1, 2025
, at the

Office of the Dean, Faculty of Physical and Numerical Sciences
.

All concerned are requested to take note.
